body: MidCap Financial Investment entered into a merger agreement with Ares Capital valued at approximately $10.88 per fully diluted share, comprising $1.21 in cash and Ares Capital shares, subject to adjustment. The transaction involves two successive mergers that will leave MidCap Financial Investment as a wholly owned subsidiary of Ares Capital, with closing anticipated in the first half of 2027, subject to stockholder approval and other conditions.
